title: Pain au Chocolat Pudding
description: A bread and butter pudding using pains au chocolat, double cream and eggs for a sweet, stodgy, chocolatey bake — perfect on a wintry afternoon.
steps: Lightly grease a large rectangular crumble dish. Slice the cold pains au chocolat into four pieces and arrange chocolate-side up, packing tightly in a single layer.
Heat the cream in a saucepan until just bubbling (about 5 minutes).
Lightly whisk the eggs in a bowl. Add to the hot cream, whisking vigorously. Immediately pour over the pains au chocolat.
Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Bake for 35 minutes until golden, puffed and bubbling with eggy custard.
Serve hot, with lemon zest over the top if you like.
notes: Serves 8–10. Delicious drizzled with Mars bar sauce (heat 3 chopped Mars bars with 120ml water and half a teaspoon instant coffee).
